attchmntText: Archidply Decor Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Archidply Decor Limited filed a notice regarding the advertisement of its public notice for Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company submitted a copy of the newspaper advertisement to the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange for their information and record. The filing was signed by Shyam Daga, Managing Director, with DIN 00561803. The document includes a newspaper advertisement in Kannada detailing the financial results and other corporate information. No voting results or specific financial figures are reported in this submission. The announcement serves as a routine compliance filing for the listed entity.

attchmntText: Archidply Decor Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  DEVESH DAGA as Executive Director of the company w.e.f. November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: Archidply Decor Limited has placed the appointment of Mr. Devesh Daga as Additional Director and Executive Director before shareholders for approval. The Board approved this proposal on November 13, 2026, subject to shareholder consent. Mr. Daga, holding DIN 12049858, will assume the role with effect from November 13, 2026. He currently serves as Assistant Vice President – Marketing and holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Economics and Finance. He has over 5 years of experience in marketing and business development. Mr. Daga is the son of Managing Director Shyam Daga and the nephew of Non-Executive Non-Independent Director Rajiv Daga. His responsibilities include overseeing marketing, business development, project management, and operational activities. The appointment is liable to retire by rotation and requires approval at the next general meeting within 3 months. Mr. Daga is not debarred from holding director office by any SEBI order.

attchmntText: Archidply Decor Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Archidply Decor Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026, approved by the Board of Directors on November 13, 2026. For the quarter ended 30.09.2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 1,955.25 lakhs, compared to Rs. 1,315.31 lakhs in the same period last year. The company recorded a profit before tax of Rs. 7.66 lakhs, compared to a profit of Rs. 20.67 lakhs in the previous year. Earnings per share for the quarter was Rs. 0.08. For the half year ended 30.09.2026, revenue from operations stood at Rs. 3,060.38 lakhs, versus Rs. 2,421.31 lakhs in the prior year. The company reported a loss before tax of Rs. 25.72 lakhs, compared to a profit of Rs. 1.87 lakhs in the corresponding period last year. Total assets as of 30.09.2026 were Rs. 8,282.78 lakhs. The statutory auditor issued an unqualified review report on these results.
